label: Step 5 Python state machine and steering for the guided task (hri_control.py)
declared: 2026-10-20, before any simulator or Unity run. Values from the spec (2.0 m approach, 1.0 s hold, ask once more, 0.3 m success) and from robot.json limits; not tuned on results.
frozen_note: Frozen 2026-10-20 after the development sessions trials_development_Task2_20261020_140241 (10/10), _163348 (9/10, before reask_shift_m) and _164719 (10/10), all dev seed 1. Hashes in configs/hri_frozen.json.
conventions: Unity yaw in deg (0 = +z, 90 = +x, grows clockwise from above). Bearings + = right of the robot heading. Commands to Unity (protocol v2): omega in rad/s with omega > 0 = LEFT (REP-103), pan_deg > 0 = LEFT.

drive.why: Speeds below robot.json max_speed_mps (1.0) and max_angular_speed_radps (1.0) so the drive limits never saturate the controller; endpoint stop 0.1 m leaves margin to the 0.3 m success radius.

dialog.why: approach 2.0 m, hold 1.0 s, ask once more then abort: the spec. scan_min_s = two 360 frames at 5 Hz, so one missed panorama does not decide the scan.
dialog.reask_note: Before the second ask the robot moves 0.4 m to its right (facing the person), back onto the 2.0 m circle, turns to the person and asks again; 0 = ask again from the same spot. Fixed side, declared with the layout in mind: the worker stands ahead-right of the junction facing the arriving robot, so the right side moves toward the worker's front.
dialog.max_none_gap_note: A NONE reading restarts the 1.0 s hold only if the candidate direction has not been seen for more than 0.3 s (3 pan-tilt frames at 10 Hz): one missed detection is not the worker changing the answer. A different direction always restarts the hold. 0 = strict.

safety.why: Person-in-path stop distance (robot centre to person centre) = body_and_person_m (half length 0.40 + person radius 0.25) + v * reaction_s (360 frame period 0.2 s + perception about 0.25 s + one tick) + v^2 / (2 * decel_mps2) (robot.json normal braking 0.5 m/s^2; the e-stop braking applies only when latched) + margin_m. At 0.8 m/s: 1.89 m; at the 0.4 m/s approach speed: 1.21 m, below approach_distance_m 2.0, so the worker being asked never triggers it. If no panorama result is newer than people_stale_s while driving, the robot stops.
safety.unknown_note: A person vision sees but cannot range (no ankles, feet hidden) is placed this close for the safety check: conservative; it may stop the robot, it never lets it drive on.

changes_during_development: 2026-10-20, after simulator tests (hri_sim.py; no Unity run, no evaluation): (1) the fixed 1.2 m person-in-path distance let the simulated robot hit a person who stepped into the lane (perception latency plus 0.5 m/s^2 braking need about 1.9 m at 0.8 m/s); replaced by the speed-dependent stop distance in safety. (2) With 80 % per-frame gesture coverage (FORWARD in the v1 sweep) the strict hold rule failed: any single NONE frame restarted the 1.0 s hold; added dialog.max_none_gap_s = 0.3 s. Both are design corrections, reported with strict-vs-tolerant numbers in the Step 4/5 report.

2026-10-20, after the development recheck trials_development_Task2_20261020_163348 (dev seed 1, 9/10): trial 8 aborted at J2 because YOLO11s-pose misplaced the shoulders and wrist of a clearly shown RIGHT from the ask position (frame_pan_tilt_004500 of bridge_guide_20261020_163322), and the second ask from the same standstill saw the same image. Added dialog.reask_shift_m = 0.4 (new viewpoint before the second ask). A design change after seeing development results, chosen by the owner; no threshold changed. Checked with a simulator test and a new development session (dev seed only).
